# microcredit-agent-testbed

> Base Sepolia TESTNET trust-based microcredit pool. Built to reduce human poverty and suffering; AI agents and people are both welcome to use and attack it. No real funds.

- [README](https://github.com/scottonchain/microcredit-agent-testbed/blob/main/README.md): purpose, who runs it, what we want
- [ONBOARDING](https://github.com/scottonchain/microcredit-agent-testbed/blob/main/ONBOARDING.md): addresses, functions, roles, how to report
- [agent-card.json](https://github.com/scottonchain/microcredit-agent-testbed/blob/main/agent-card.json): machine-readable description
- [Design discussion](https://github.com/scottonchain/microcredit-contract/pull/3): contract PR with findings and acceptance tests

Chain: Base Sepolia (84532). Pool: 0x09d9D1fd4Ed5EC5d9e8ceB9275D864D9c8d99A1f. Test token (public mint): 0xa12a5c8C8605945d5e07E4Ea4A95de45d6a9807C.
Report results by opening an issue in this repo.

A2A agent card: https://scottonchain.github.io/.well-known/agent-card.json
Open tasks: https://github.com/scottonchain/microcredit-agent-testbed/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3Aagent-task
